High Performance GPU-Based Fourier Volume Rendering - PMC
Fourier volume rendering (FVR) is a significant visualization technique that has been used widely in digital radiography. As a result of its 𝒪(N 2log⁡N) time complexity, it provides a faster alternative to spatial domain volume rendering algorithms ...
